stories.headline: Quest v72 update: faster hand tracking, glance-to-connect PC
stories.subtitle: Look at a PC and tap Connect for Remote Desktop; more stable hand cursor and passthrough keyboard tracking.

stories.headline: Gen 3 in stores at $449; camera-free Audio ships Oct 13
stories.subtitle: Gen 3 adds Aviator, Zena, a slimmer build and longer battery; the $349 camera-free Audio line ships Oct 13.

stories.headline: Quest 3 512GB ~30% off via Meta's eBay storefront
stories.subtitle: IGN flags the deal during the October Prime Day period — well under the $599.99 retail price; check the listing at checkout.

stories.headline: Dutch backlash grows: hospitals told to bar camera glasses
stories.subtitle: Dutch hospital association NVZ advises keeping the devices out; eyewear chain Hans Anders halted sales at 400 stores.

stories.headline: Anti-smart-glasses detector apps go mainstream
stories.subtitle: Popular Science spotlights apps like Nearby Glasses and ZuckOff that scan Bluetooth to warn when camera glasses are nearby.
